name: Lenus
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: the patron god of the Treveri

text: Lenus was a Celtic god honored in Gaul and parts of Britain. He was the ancestral god of the Treveri, a tribe of the Rhineland. Stone statues show him standing beside a large bird, likely a goose. The pairing may mark his link to a goose goddess.

okr.objective: Record the god of the Treveri.
